facts.text: The hotel sits amid the cobbled streets of Downtown Manhattan's historic South Street Seaport.
facts.excerpt: nestled amidst the cobbled streets of Downtown

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by views of the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the New York City skyline.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by breathtaking views of the East River, Brooklyn Bridge, and New York City skyline

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a landmarked red-brick building at 33 Peck Slip that blends with the Seaport District's Georgian and Federal-style architecture.
facts.excerpt: Located at 33 Peck Slip, 33 Hotel, New York City, Seaport is housed in a landmarked, red-bricked building that integrates seamlessly with the Georgian and Federal-style architecture

facts.text: Rooms have teak veneer finishes, rainfall showers, plush linens and 50-inch interactive 4K televisions.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully appointed with teak veneer finishes, rainfall showers, plush linens, and 50

facts.text: Select accommodations have private terraces overlooking the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Lower Manhattan skyline.
facts.excerpt: Select accommodations feature private terraces overlooking the East River, Brooklyn Bridge, and the evolving skyline of Lower Manhattan.

facts.text: The Brooklyn Bridge Suite Terrace has a furnished wraparound terrace with views of Lower Manhattan, the Brooklyn Bridge and the East River.
facts.excerpt: Greet the day from a furnished, wraparound terrace.

facts.text: The Brooklyn Bridge Grand Terrace Suite has two full-sized white marble bathrooms and a separate living room.
facts.excerpt: This room is also appointed with two full-sized white marble bathrooms, a separate living room features a large wooden desk, comfortable sofa, and two velvet chairs.

facts.text: Loft rooms have an arched window with views of the Brooklyn Bridge.
facts.excerpt: An intimate room with an arched window with views of the Brooklyn Bridge.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: guestrooms and suites with marble bathrooms, soft natural light, plush textures

facts.text: Guests get exclusive offers from neighborhood partners, including sailing excursions with Manhattan By Sail and classes at Seaport Pilates.
facts.excerpt: exclusive offers from our neighborhood partners, including sailing excursions with Manhattan By Sail, classes at Seaport Pilates

facts.text: Urban Cove Society & Kitchen serves Modern American cuisine with global influences.
facts.excerpt: Merging Modern American cuisine with global influences

facts.text: Urban Cove Society & Kitchen faces cobblestone-lined Peck Slip and has a dining room, bar and seasonal outdoor patio.
facts.excerpt: which faces the cobblestone-lined Peck Slip and offers a casual yet refined dining room, bar, and outdoor seasonal patio

facts.text: The hotel has no spa, but it has a gym.
facts.excerpt: There’s no spa, but the gym is stocked with the latest wellness and workout equipment.

facts.text: Pier 17 and the Brooklyn Bridge are a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It’s a short walk to Pier 17, home of performance venues and a range of restaurants and bars, and to the Brooklyn Bridge

facts.text: The nearest subway is about a 10-minute walk away.
facts.excerpt: about a 10-minute walk to the nearest subway

facts.text: Pets are welcome for a small fee, with a maximum of two pets.
facts.excerpt: Pet-Friendly accommodations are available for a small fee. Maximum of two pets.

facts.text: Self-parking is available at a neighboring garage.
facts.excerpt: Self-parking is available at neighboring garage

facts.text: Bellhops welcome guests and share the inside scoop on New York City.
facts.excerpt: Our bellhops are ready to welcome you and share the inside scoop on New York City.

facts.text: The hotel opened in early 2024 as a boutique property from Crescent Hotels & Resorts.
facts.excerpt: opened in early 2024 as a new boutique property from award-winning Crescent Hotels & Resorts

facts.excerpt: from roll-in showers and AV-equipped doorbells for the hearing impaired to widened doorways and lowered sinks
